issues.description: Aufgabe 01: The problem statement requires four output columns (the zoo name, the zoo internet address/url, the Gemeinde name, and the Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk). The template SELECT (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql) only selects 'Zoo.name' and 'Gemeinde.name'. The provided solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) selects 'Zoo.name' and 'Zoo.url AS Internetadresse' but does not include 'Gemeinde.name' or 'Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk'. This mismatch between the problem statement and both template/solution about which column identifiers must appear in the query will confuse students about the expected result columns and lead to graded answers not matching the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected output columns consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement to match the solution/template, or (preferable) update the template and the solution so the SELECT returns the four columns requested by the problem: Zoo.name, Zoo.url (Internetadresse), Gemeinde.name, and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. Example correction for solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name AS Gemeinde_name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo JOIN Gemeinde ON Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel; Also update template_repository/aufgabe01.sql to provide a starter that includes the required columns (or a commented hint) so students are not misled.
